title: Towards Comprehensive Post Safety Alignment of Large Language Models via Safety Patching
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework (SAFEPATCHING) for safety alignment in LLMs, specifically addressing safety vulnerabilities and over-safety (false rejections). While it mentions aligning models with human values, its evaluations are based on safety benchmarks (like AdvBench and XSTest) and general utility tasks, rather than specifically benchmarking religion, faith, or moral/ethical reasoning systems.
